description: Read one library catalog entry by ID, returning its frontmatter record and body. Use it after library_search resolves the ID; do not use it to search (library_search) or to read modules, pipelines, or assets (module_read / pipeline_read / asset_read). The ID is the canonical stem without the .md suffix and matching is case-insensitive (for example NF-1); an unknown ID returns an error carrying the requested value and repair guidance. Reads one local file and returns its full text without truncation. Local-only; no auth or rate limits.

entry_id.description: Catalog ID, case-insensitive (for example NF-1 or nf-worldcampus-monyeah777-1).

name: library_read

outputSchema.description: A catalog entry with its metadata and full Markdown body.

found.description: True when the entry was located.

frontmatter.description: Parsed YAML frontmatter as JSON; keys vary by entry.

text.description: Full Markdown body as stored on disk.

title: Read library entry
